integrity: Includes a full elementary proof, a standalone standard-library exhaustive verifier, and actual finite-run output; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to rank-two translation subgroups of binary Hamming Vietoris–Rips complexes at scales at most three; neither other subgroups nor full equivariant homotopy types are classified. The proof is internal and independent validation has not been performed.
title: Rank-two translation fixed spaces in the scale-three Hamming Rips filtration
